description: Share of individual CPI items (all-India combined, unweighted) with y/y above and below zero, and the diffusion index (rising minus falling), monthly from Jan 2015: 2012 base (299 items, y/y from MoSPI item indices) to Dec 2025, 2024 base (358 items, MoSPI published y/y) from Jan 2026 (basis column). Mar-May 2020 and 2021 missing. Asia Decoded calculation; built by the AsiaDecoded/asia-vitals pipeline (data/in/cpi_core/in_cpi_diffusion.csv).
schedule: Replaced after each release by a scheduled task that reads AsiaDecoded/asia-vitals.
title: India CPI diffusion index
